label.purpose: Terms, column heads, legends, run-in labels and plate numbers.

figure.purpose: Measured values in particulars and tables.

motion.name: ease

motion.name: state-swap

components.css: .ds-plate { margin:0; padding:16px; background:var(--page,#f2f5f3); color:var(--ink,#0e1512); font-family:'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-drawing { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; } .ds-ink { fill:none; stroke:var(--ink,#0e1512); stroke-width:1.4; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-hull { stroke-width:2.2; } .ds-wl { stroke:var(--ink,#0e1512); stroke-width:1; stroke-dasharray:14 4 2 4; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-st { stroke:var(--ink,#0e1512); stroke-width:.6; stroke-dasharray:2 4; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-dim line { stroke:var(--ink,#0e1512); stroke-width:.8; vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-dim text { font:600 11px 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; fill:var(--ink,#0e1512); font-variation-settings:'wdth' 85; paint-order:stroke; stroke:var(--page,#f2f5f3); stroke-width:5px; } .ds-plate figcaption { font-size:.875rem; color:var(--ink-2,#33433b); margin-top:8px; padding-top:8px; border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#0e1512); } .ds-plate figcaption span { font-weight:800; color:var(--ink,#0e1512); margin-right:.4em; }

narrative.overview:
Every surface reads as one entry in a naval reference annual: a vessel set down in black ink on cool white paper, measured, lettered and cross-referenced, with deep grey-green bookcloth binding whole fields of the page. The vessel is never photographed or rendered; it is drawn as a naval architect's lines plan (profile, half-breadth, body plan) with stations, waterlines, dimension callouts and a scale bar. The drawings are the imagery and the component language at once.

The system is two inks and one signal. Ink and page carry the content; bookcloth owns entire bands (masthead, the mission field, the enquiry field) rather than tinting small surfaces; signal orange appears only where something is actionable or has just changed. Density is that of a reference work: hairline rules between every row, tabular lining figures everywhere, labels set narrow and heavy, values set right-aligned and bold. Nothing floats, nothing is rounded, nothing glows.

Motion is short and declarative: a drawing inks itself once on load, a changed value lights orange and holds its light until the next change. Everything else is a colour swap.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks (ink on page, cloth-ink on cloth) plus one signal orange
Lines-plan drawings as the only imagery, built in SVG with non-scaling strokes
Hairline (1px) and heavy (2px) ink rules as the structural device; no cards, no shadows
One variable family (Archivo) doing all work through width and weight axes
Lettered references (A to E) that tie table rows to dimensions on the drawings

rules.name: The Change-State Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks only two things: the action to take and the value that just changed. It never decorates, never fills a section, never colours a heading.

rules.name: The Whole-Field Rule
rules.body: Bookcloth is applied to full-bleed bands, never to cards or chips. A surface on cloth uses cloth-ink and cloth-ink-2; a drawing inside a cloth field sits on its own page-coloured plate.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: No greys outside the defined inks, no gradients, no photography. Secondary text uses ink-2 or cloth-ink-2, never opacity.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is a tabular lining figure, set with thousands separators and units (8,323 mm, 1,300 kg).

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is made with `wdth` and weight, not with additional families. Narrower and heavier means more structural.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Separation is a ruled line or a change of field, never a shadow or a card.

dos: **Do** draw the vessel; show it as a lines plan with stations, waterlines, lettered dimensions and a scale bar.
**Do** reserve signal orange (signal) for the primary action, the selected marker and changed values.
**Do** give bookcloth whole bands; place drawings inside a cloth field on a page-coloured plate.
**Do** separate with ink rules: 2px to open a group, 1px between rows.
**Do** set every figure tabular and lining, with thousands separators and units.
**Do** build hierarchy with Archivo's width axis and weight: condensed heavy heads, narrow heavy labels.
**Do** caption every drawing with a bold plate number on a 1px rule; label illustrative payloads as schematic.
donts: **Don't** use photography, renders, gradients or decorative imagery; the client brief retired photorealistic imagery.
**Don't** add shadows, cards or rounded corners.
**Don't** introduce greys or colours beyond the seven tokens, or fade text with opacity.
**Don't** use signal orange for headings, section fills or decoration.
**Don't** place small uppercase labels above headings; section heads are a headline plus a paragraph on a rule.
**Don't** name the hull's manufacturer anywhere, in copy, drawings, alt text or file names; the vessel is OmniHopper.
